**once per day at 09:00 in the account time zone** (IANA name, default `UTC`) … Weekends are not skipped. … configurable send time, other channels, business-day calendars.
remaining balance as `<CURRENCY> <amount>` in the currency's minor units

to the invoice's **single** billing-contact address: exactly one `To`, **no Cc/Bcc**.
